title: Virtual Compute: assisted credit — settlement corrected amount
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute assisted credit — Apply the settlement concession once to the already rounded reviewed net amount and round the resulting final corrected pretax amount half-up to two USD decimals; this concession is a second successive reduction, never a rate added to the earlier pricing adjustment.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted credit — settlement corrected amount?**

Apply the settlement concession once to the already rounded reviewed net amount and round the resulting final corrected pretax amount half-up to two USD decimals; this concession is a second successive reduction, never a rate added to the earlier pricing adjustment.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetically, the already rounded reviewed subtotal is 83.37 USD and the settlement reduction is 10%. Acting on that subtotal gives 75.033 USD, rounded half-up to 75.03 USD.
